question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position, reinforced by the 2018 removal of presidential term limits and sustained centralization of authority over the Chinese Communist Party, military, and state institutions, underpins the market's 95.5% implied probability that he remains in power through 2026. Recent military leadership changes have been interpreted as further consolidation rather than erosion of control, while public appearances and policy directives through mid-2026 show no signals of transition. Trader consensus reflects the absence of viable succession mechanisms or organized opposition within elite circles. Health developments, unforeseen elite fractures, or acute crises could still introduce volatility, though such paths lack supporting evidence at present.
